featured_reviews.name: Pankaj Powermax
featured_reviews.review_text:
INOX at Thakur Mall in Dahisar is a popular entertainment hub for residents in the Dahisar and Mira Road areas. Located on the 3rd floor of the mall, it is known for being a well-maintained multiplex that offers a premium cinematic experience at relatively competitive prices compared to other major malls in Mumbai.
Screens: The multiplex typically operates 4 screens, featuring both 2D and 3D projection technology.
​Seating: Options range from standard comfortable seating to luxury recliners (Gold Class) for a more relaxed experience.
​Audio/Visual: Equipped with high-quality sound systems, including Dolby Atmos in select halls, and large screens with high-definition picture quality.
​Accessibility: The cinema is equipped with wheelchair facilities and elevator access.
Refreshments: There is a dedicated F&B counter inside INOX serving classic movie snacks like popcorn, nachos, and sandwiches.
​Food Court: Thakur Mall itself has a multi-cuisine food court on the lower floors, offering a wider variety of dining options after the movie.
​Gaming Zone: There is a gaming area located within the mall, making it a good spot for families and children.
If you're visiting on a weekend, it's advisable to book tickets in advance via apps like BookMyShow, as it is a major landmark and can get quite crowded for blockbuster releases.
Safety system is very nice handle nicely .

featured_reviews.review_text: INOX Thakur Mall - Mira Road really impressed me! 🤩 The atmosphere was absolutely fantastic, and I had such a wonderful time. The staff was super friendly and made my visit extra special. 😊 I particularly loved the comfortable seating and the crystal-clear screen. 🎬 The snack bar had some delicious options too! 🍿😋 I'm definitely planning another trip soon; it's a great spot for a fun outing! 👍 it's just they don't have an Imax screen which is a must at every Inox Cinema 🎥📽️

featured_reviews.name: Keval Somaiya
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re someone who enjoys ads more than movies, this theatre is absolutely perfect for you.

Showtime? More like “suggested time.” I’ve been here multiple times, and without fail, every single show starts 20–30 minutes late. Honestly, you could walk in 20 minutes after the scheduled time and still comfortably sit through a full ad marathon before the movie even begins.

At this point, missing a scene here is nearly impossible—not because of great service, but because punctuality clearly isn’t part of the experience.

It’s hard to tell whether the staff is just taking it easy or the management has created some magical, impossible turnaround schedule between shows. Either way, the result is the same: frustration.

A 2-hour movie somehow turns into a 3-hour commitment. Impressive… just not in the way you’d want.

Would not recommend if you value your time.

Had a terrible experience watching Project Hail Mary in Screen 2 of this theater.

Seats are comfortable, but the hall had a sweaty smell, it was probably the AC/ventilation not working properly.

The film started playing with the lights turned ON inside the hall. It was only after 5-10 minutes into the film that the lights were turned off. And then the film was restarted.

Since Project Hail Mary has multiple aspect ratios you can expect pillarboxing (black sides) coming and going as the scenes change during the film. But what you don't want is an uncalibrated projector scaling on the screen - a small gap in the top and bottom of the screen, which never goes away because the projector is not set up properly.

Speaking of which, the image rendering is good, I could see the grains too, but the focus was just a bit off. Moreover, the screen was dirty in the center right with a huge mark. Looked like someone tried to clean but accidentally smeared. It blackened the projection in that spot.

The audio was average, but the center channel had a constant loud buzzing. Which was a major distraction in the experience of the film.

Overall it felt like watching a pirated copy of the film in some second-hand theater setup. Definitely not satisfactory or worth the time. The ticket prices were INR 91/- so I felt like they deliberately choose the worse performing screen (Screen 2).

I believe that Miraj Cinemas can do so much better. Not everyone wants to watch Dhurandhar, so please take good care of ALL of your customers.

Audio: 4/10
Video: 5/10
Ticket price: Rs. 91 (the experience shouldn't reflect that)

I am writing this review to document a serious food safety incident at PVR, Jio World Plaza, BKC.

On 15 January 2026, I attended the 6:00 PM show of Avatar 3 in Audi 6. Before the movie, I purchased food from the PVR counter. While eating it during the show, the final bite contained a visible piece of glass that entered my mouth. I immediately spat it out. The fact that I was not physically injured was purely a matter of luck, this could have caused severe internal injury or worse.

I have video evidence clearly showing the glass shard in the food.

What has been equally disturbing is the way this matter has been handled since. Despite multiple emails, follow-ups, and assurances that the issue was being taken seriously, there were significant delays, inconsistent communication, and ultimately a response stating that no lapse could be established at their end. The only gesture initially offered was complimentary movie tickets, which is entirely inappropriate for a life-threatening food safety incident.

As a paying customer, being exposed to such a risk and then experiencing weeks of delay and deflection has been deeply distressing. This review is being posted so that other patrons are aware and so that this concern is documented publicly after private escalation failed to lead to a responsible resolution.

I hope PVR reviews its food safety accountability and customer handling practices more seriously going forward.

featured_reviews.name: Deep Rajgor

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

NY Cinemas Mulund is one of the better theatres compared to many others I’ve visited. The best part is the location – just a 2-minute walk from Mulund railway station, which makes it very convenient.

🎬 My Experience:
I’ve watched many films here – Pushpa, Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3, Chandu Champion, Dunki, and more. Every time, the experience has been quite good overall.

🛋️ Seats:
The seats are very comfortable and better than most nearby theatres. Sitting through a 2.5 to 3-hour movie feels easy and relaxed.

❄️ AC (Important Point):
This is the same issue I’ve noticed in almost every theatre nowadays – the AC is not as strong or consistent as before. Back in the 2000–2017 era, theatres used to keep the cooling so high that people carried jackets just to watch movies. In fact, some people even bought tickets only to sleep in the theatre because the AC was so powerful! Now, that unique theatre “chill” experience is gone. The AC here is okay, but not at the superior level it once used to be.

Also, ticket prices have increased a lot. Sometimes, when another theatre is charging ₹130, here it may go up to ₹200. With higher prices, at least the AC should be maintained well.

🔊 Sound & Screen:
The sound quality is balanced with new technology – dialogues are clear, music and effects are impactful without being too loud. The screen size is medium – not too big, not too small – just right for a good movie outing.

👋 Staff & Entry:
The staff are professional, though unlike some theatres (like Miraj), I didn’t notice greetings like “Good Evening” at the entry. Small gestures like that add a nice human touch, but it’s fine.

⏳ Waiting Area:
If you arrive too early, there isn’t much waiting or seating space outside the halls. Better to come on time, as space is limited.

✅ Overall:
A reliable theatre near Mulund station with comfortable seats, decent AC (though not as great as the old days), good sound, and medium-sized screen. Convenient for regular movie-goers like me and definitely better than a lot of nearby options.

featured_reviews.name: Neeta
featured_reviews.review_text: This is my first time at Devgn Cinemas. I had high expectations thinking it was Ajay Devgns cinema chain but the experience is very disappointing. I came here to watch Dhurandar 2 . I paid 350+ for premium seat but the seating was very uncomfortable. At first i thought since the lights are on the screen is blurry and sound is slow. But the projection is bad and a blue light shadow is constantly on the screen in the background when while the movie is on, Colors are faded and maybe the projector is poor so you won't get a cinema experience and sound quality is even worse. From someone coming from a film fraternity they should have worked on all the factors while opening a cinema chain. I think maybe Ajay Devgn should personally come and experience it to understand the issue. People come to a cinema hall for experience but this was a disaster. The movie was not even over and the lights got switched on around 10 mins prior when we asked to switch off they said arre movie almost over hi toh hai. Over all not a great experience here would surely not recommend or come back.

featured_reviews.name: Jaimeen Bulsara
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a wonderful experience at Ajanta Cinex. This was our second time coming here. Tucked away in a by-lane, very close to the station (if you’re coming by train) as well as ample parking (if you prefer to come by car/bike) it is super convenient to reach. The movie watching experience itself is amazing, it is currently the only single screen theatre with Dolby sound system. Clean, comfortable seating, delicious food options (we tried the momos, pizza, and coffee, along with the usual samosa and popcorn). The freshly made momos and pizza were better than some of the food places we’ve eaten at. Overall a total 5 on 5 experience. Would definitely come again soon.

featured_reviews.name: Jeevan Nagarkar
featured_reviews.review_text: The staff seemed untrained. The theatre was renovated, but cleaning needs attention there was a slight smell inside, not too strong but enough to distract while watching the movie. They should also put clear directions outside the mall since there are two entrances. At one entrance, the watchman was chewing gutka and just threw hand signs when I asked where the theatre was, which didn’t feel professional. Another odd thing was at the last 10 minutes of the movie, the lights were turned on while it was still playing. On the positive side, the ticket prices were low, the seats were good, and the washrooms were clean, so overall 3 stars for that

The newly opened INOX is genuinely impressive, modern, clean, and equipped with comfortable seating and great sound quality. The overall movie experience feels fresh and well-designed, making it a wonderful addition for cinema lovers in the area.
However, there is one noticeable drawback: to enter the theatre, you have to walk through the crowded food court. During peak hours, this can be inconvenient and a bit chaotic, especially if you're trying to make it to your show on time

featured_reviews.name: Dhara Milind
featured_reviews.review_text:
PVR Insigna = big disappointment. ₹1550/ticket (₹3100 for 2) wasn't worth it. Viviana Mall's VIP PVR's way better & cheaper.

Seats & sound were fine, food tasted good...but pricey (₹700 pasta, ₹390 shake). Paid premium prices, expected premium service. Didn't get it 😔.

Pressed bell multiple times; staff ignored. "No notification" excuse 🤷‍♂️. 40-minute wait for a shake that wasn't available 🤯. Missed movie because of this.

₹1550 deserves better service. Short-staffed? Not our problem.

featured_reviews.name: Sanket Savaliya
featured_reviews.review_text: Good theater in Sky city mall, this has 10 screens but most of them are small, they have smartly designed small theater so that they can increase the number of screens and also do marketing by saying all the shows are house full,  overall liked it, good ambience, luxury vibes, hygene well maintained and you can directly get down from metro to this mall, which is big plus point, food here is very expenssive specially pop corn but you have wednesday offer of unlimited refill, burgers dont ever dare to try here as they dont have proper chef who can prepare tasty burgers and other food

featured_reviews.name: Hitesh KHATRI
featured_reviews.review_text: Been twice to the Insignia screen at the Inox Sky City Mall,  very nice theater, very comfortable recliner seating. The screen could be larger, but perfectly fine for the size of the theater.  Nice Insignia Lounge to relax before the movie and also dedicated bathrooms for Insignia.  Ordered Margherita Pizza, it was good, could have been a little more crispy crust, but taste was good, delivered to my seat in the theater.  Also,  had a cappuccino on second visit in lounge area while waiting for the movie time. The menu is extensive with lots of veg and non veg options.   Very nice experience overall, would recommend.

featured_reviews.name: Omkar Iyer
featured_reviews.review_text: It's on par with other theatres in Mumbai, and that's about it. This one in particular has many screens, so expect a crowd at all times. The ambience felt decent, considering that it is fairly new establishment. Overall, a good experience!
